messages:
Nora (Finance): @channel Heads-up: we're changing token billing granularity. Starting 2026-11-01 UTC, we will bill generation tokens at 0.1-token granularity (previously rounded up to whole tokens) to reduce apparent overcharges on short responses.

Nora (Finance): Why: rounding up was causing consistent small overages for many customers (esp. embeddings + short prompts). Moving to 0.1-token steps keeps invoices closer to actual usage and reduces support noise. No price-per-token change — purely granularity.

Jin (Billing): Implementation notes: - billing pipeline will compute tokens_consumed = floor(raw_tokens*10)/10 and round to nearest 0.1 for invoice lines. - We'll add invoice flag `token_granularity=0.1` to invoices issued post-cutover. - Backfill? No. Historical invoices remain unchanged.

Ravi (Product): Dev requests for eng: expose X-Token-Granularity header on responses and a /billing/preview endpoint that shows estimated invoice impact for the last 30 days with old vs new granularity. We want the console preview live on 2026-10-20.

Clara (Support): Playbook: - If customer reports small deltas (<5%) on a prior invoice, explain change and point to preview tool. - If a customer saw a sudden jump >5% post-cutover, escalate to #billing-escalations. - Add template responses. I'll publish a short support doc.

Hannah (Legal): Legal note: include sentence in email: "We are updating billing granularity to reflect measured usage more accurately; this does not change per-token prices." I'll post final wording.

Nora (Finance): Customer impact: most customers will see minor decreases on micro-billed items; some will be unchanged. We expect a drop in small disputed tickets. Safety valve: if >1% of invoices in first 7 days show >10% delta vs preview, we will pause and investigate.

ops-billing-bot: preview_job: queued -> scheduled 2026-10-10T02:00:00Z

Jin (Billing): Data task: run preview comparing old-roundup vs 0.1-step for all invoices in last 90 days. Flag accounts with >7% change and include columns: account_id, old_tokens, new_tokens, pct_delta, migration_id. Due 2026-10-05.

Ravi (Product): UX copy for console preview: "Starting Nov 1, 2026 we will bill tokens in 0.1-token increments to better match actual token usage. Preview how this affects your recent invoices." Include a toggle to show per-route breakdown.

Clara (Support): Sample reply: 

"Hi <customer>, we updated token rounding to 0.1-token granularity on 1 Nov 2026 to reduce small overcharges. Your prior invoices are unchanged, but you can preview expected impact here: <link>. If you see >5% difference, we'll escalate. — Clara"

Nora (Finance): Timeline: - 2026-10-05: preview CSV to teams - 2026-10-10: console preview job run - 2026-10-20: preview widget live in console - 2026-11-01: cutover (invoices show token_granularity=0.1) - 7-day monitoring window post-cutover.

Hannah (Legal): Reminder: any customer communications that mention billing must be cleared by legal before send.

Jin (Billing): Ops: we'll emit billing.event.token_granularity_change.v1 at cutover and include migration_id on invoice metadata.

Clara (Support): :thumbsup: scheduling training for agents 2026-10-22.

Nora (Finance): Action items: Jin -> preview CSV by 2026-10-05; Eng -> preview endpoint + header by 2026-10-20; Support -> training + doc by 2026-10-22; Legal -> final email line by 2026-10-03.
